name: Kamo (Niigata, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kamo city emblem in white: an outlined ring with a serrated edge enclosing a ring with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Kamo, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1934.

features.role: Kamo city emblem — an outlined ring with a serrated edge enclosing a ring with a vertical bar
